messages:
Lina (eng-platform): Heads-up — Priya wants a new set of zone-level panels for the console MVP next sprint. We need runtime + infra telemetry inputs (what we already emit, latency dimensions, cardinality risks). Can runtime/infra owners weigh in?
Akash (eng-runtime): We already emit: `request_latency_ms` (p50/p90/p99) with tags: region, zone, model_variant, route; `queue_time_ms`; `kv_cache_hit` boolean; `response_tokens`; `error_code`. Mostly via dogstatsd -> prometheus. Note: model_variant tag multiplies cardinality.
Maya (eng-infra): From infra side we can add: `egress_proxy_latency_ms` (per region pair), `zone_utilization_pct`, `available_gpu_count` (tiered), `traffic_split_ratio` (per deployment). Telemetry path has ~1m scrape lag. Also: cross-zone failover events are emitted to `failover_events_total{from_zone,to_zone}`.
Noah (observability): Proposed panel set: 1) p95 end-to-end request latency by region (line chart) 2) failover events heatmap (from_zone -> to_zone) 3) traffic split ratio by route (stacked area) 4) capacity vs latency correlation. Example PromQLs: 
```
# p95 latency by region
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, region))

# cross-region failover rate (1h)
sum(increase(failover_events_total[1h])) by (to_zone) / sum(increase(requests_total[1h]))
```
Noah (observability): We should prefix metrics with `redwood.runtime.zone_*` to make dashboards consumable and avoid mixing with infra-only metrics.
Priya (product): UI asks: ability to pick a model_variant and compare zones side-by-side. Retention request: 90 days for trend analysis. Also want a single-number impact estimate for a rollout: "expected tail-latency delta if routed to zone B" (approx).
Oliver (eng-sre): +1 for region panels. Big caution: model_variant x route x region = cardinality explosion. We need either: 1) limit model_variant label cardinality (only `serving_variant` for ringed rollouts), or 2) provide sampled telemetry for high-cardinality combos. Also need alerts: p95 > X ms for > 5m, and failover rate spike > 1% of requests.
Akash (eng-runtime): Agree on limits. Proposal: emit full labels for `request_latency_ms` but only for canary/baseline tags during rollout. For everything else emit aggregated `region`-level metrics (no model_variant). Implementation plan: add a boolean tag `detailed=true` for canaries. We'll also emit `traffic_split_ratio{deployment,region}`.
Akash (eng-runtime): Implementation snippet (Go):
```
// emit aggregated region p95 (aggregated path)
dogstatsd.Gauge("redwood.runtime.zone.request_latency_ms", p50, []string{"region:"+r})
// detailed metrics only for canary
if isCanary {
  dogstatsd.Gauge("redwood.runtime.zone.request_latency_ms_detailed", p50, []string{"region:"+r, "model_variant:"+mv})
}
```
Maya (eng-infra): We'll need a small infra change: route telemetry pipeline to add `to_zone` mapping for failover events and ensure prometheus relabeling drops high-cardinality labels for long retention. I'll own the relabel rules PR.
Noah (observability): Dashboard layout requests: 3 rows — latency summary, traffic & split, failover matrix. I'll mock PromQL panels and export a JSON dashboard draft. Can we keep default time window 6h, allow comparison to 7d?
Priya (product): That works. Also add a tiny UX affordance in Rollouts: toggle to "collect detailed metrics" for a rollout. That flips `isCanary` and shows the per-variant panels.
Oliver (eng-sre): For alerts, suggest we start with: p95(region) > 800ms for > 5m -> pager; failover_rate increase > 0.5% in 10m -> page. We'll tune thresholds after 1 week.
Lina (eng-platform): Ok owners & next steps: Akash -> runtime instrumentation PR (due EOD Fri). Maya -> relabel rules + retention plan (due Tue). Noah -> dashboard JSON + PromQL (mock by Wed). Priya -> Rollouts UX copy & toggle spec (Tue). Oliver -> alert rule PR (Fri). I'll add a weekly 30m sync on Tues for 4 weeks to iterate. Anyone object?
Priya (product): No objections. Also, please keep retention cost in mind — I'll coordinate finance if 90d increases storage.
rollout-bot: Note: Changing metric labels/schema will require a rollout-runbook update and will trigger the telemetry-schema-check in CI.
Akash (eng-runtime): Noted. I’ll add schema docs and a short migration note in the PR.
Lina (eng-platform): Thanks all — I'll post the Figma link + meeting invite once Noah shares the dashboard draft. :thumbsup:
